proposed.title: Inverse and implicit function theorems
proposed.subject: Real analysis
proposed.why: When a smooth map can be inverted locally; the analytic basis of manifolds, constraints and changes of coordinates.

proposed.title: Arzelà–Ascoli and Stone–Weierstrass theorems
proposed.subject: Real analysis
proposed.why: Compactness and density in spaces of functions; used in existence proofs for ODEs and PDEs and in approximation.

proposed.title: Signed measures and the Radon–Nikodym theorem
proposed.subject: Real analysis
proposed.why: Densities, absolute continuity and differentiation of measures; the basis of conditional expectation and likelihood ratios.

proposed.title: L^p spaces
proposed.subject: Real analysis
proposed.why: The standard function spaces of analysis, probability and quantum mechanics; Hölder, Minkowski, completeness and duality.

proposed.title: Entire functions and infinite products
proposed.subject: Complex analysis
proposed.why: Weierstrass products and Hadamard factorisation; the product over zeros used for the zeta and gamma functions.

proposed.title: Conformal maps and the Riemann mapping theorem
proposed.subject: Complex analysis
proposed.why: Angle-preserving maps and the classification of simply connected domains; solves 2D potential problems in physics.

proposed.title: Elliptic and theta functions
proposed.subject: Complex analysis
proposed.why: Doubly periodic functions and theta series: the analytic side of elliptic curves, used for sums of squares and modular forms.

proposed.title: Dual spaces and quotient spaces
proposed.subject: Linear algebra
proposed.why: Linear functionals, dual bases and transposes; covectors are needed for tensors, differential forms and bra-ket notation.

proposed.title: Tensor products and exterior algebra
proposed.subject: Linear algebra
proposed.why: Multilinear algebra: tensors, symmetric and alternating products, the wedge product; the algebra behind tensor calculus and entanglement.

proposed.title: Solvable and nilpotent groups
proposed.subject: Algebra
proposed.why: Composition series, Jordan–Hölder, p-groups; solvability is what Galois theory turns into solvability by radicals.

proposed.title: Unique factorisation domains
proposed.subject: Algebra
proposed.why: Euclidean domains, PIDs and UFDs, Gauss's lemma and irreducibility criteria; where unique factorisation holds and where it fails.

proposed.title: Modules
proposed.subject: Algebra
proposed.why: Modules over rings and the structure theorem over a PID, which classifies finitely generated abelian groups and gives rational and Jordan forms.

proposed.title: Homological algebra
proposed.subject: Algebra
proposed.why: Chain complexes, exact sequences, derived functors, Ext and Tor; the common language of homology, sheaf cohomology and group cohomology.

proposed.title: Noetherian rings
proposed.subject: Commutative algebra
proposed.why: Chain conditions, Hilbert's basis theorem and Artin rings: the finiteness that makes algebraic geometry work.

proposed.title: Localisation
proposed.subject: Commutative algebra
proposed.why: Rings and modules of fractions; how to study a ring one prime at a time.

proposed.title: Representations of finite groups
proposed.subject: Representation theory and Lie theory
proposed.why: Groups acting linearly on vector spaces; Maschke's theorem and irreducible decompositions. Symmetry in quantum mechanics is described this way.

proposed.title: Character theory
proposed.subject: Representation theory and Lie theory
proposed.why: Characters and the orthogonality relations determine representations; generalises Dirichlet characters to nonabelian groups.

proposed.title: Lie groups
proposed.subject: Representation theory and Lie theory
proposed.why: Groups that are also manifolds, such as SO(3), SU(2) and GL(n); continuous symmetries of physics.

proposed.title: Lie algebras
proposed.subject: Representation theory and Lie theory
proposed.why: The infinitesimal version of a Lie group, joined to it by the exponential map; first classification in low dimensions.

proposed.title: Representations of sl(2)
proposed.subject: Representation theory and Lie theory
proposed.why: Highest-weight representations of the smallest simple Lie algebra; the mathematics of spin and angular momentum.

proposed.title: Semisimple Lie algebras
proposed.subject: Representation theory and Lie theory
proposed.why: Roots, weights and the representations of sl(3), sl(n) and sp(2n); the structure theory behind particle-physics symmetry groups.

proposed.title: Topological spaces
proposed.subject: Topology
proposed.why: Open sets, continuity, products, quotients and connectedness without a metric.

proposed.title: Fundamental group and covering spaces
proposed.subject: Topology
proposed.why: Loops up to homotopy form a group, computed with covering spaces; the first algebraic invariant of a space.

proposed.title: Free groups and the van Kampen theorem
proposed.subject: Topology
proposed.why: Computing fundamental groups by gluing; free groups and group presentations.

proposed.title: Classification of surfaces
proposed.subject: Topology
proposed.why: Every compact surface is a sphere with handles or crosscaps, distinguished by orientability and Euler characteristic.

proposed.title: Homology
proposed.subject: Topology
proposed.why: Simplicial and singular homology, exact sequences and Mayer–Vietoris; counts holes in every dimension.

proposed.title: Cohomology and Poincaré duality
proposed.subject: Topology
proposed.why: Cohomology rings, cup products and Poincaré duality for manifolds; leads to characteristic classes and the Hodge conjecture.

proposed.title: Homotopy groups and fibrations
proposed.subject: Topology
proposed.why: Higher homotopy groups, fibrations and their long exact sequence; classify topological defects and instantons in physics.

proposed.title: Curves in space and the Frenet frame
proposed.subject: Differential geometry
proposed.why: Curvature and torsion determine a space curve up to rigid motion.

proposed.title: Surfaces and Gaussian curvature
proposed.subject: Differential geometry
proposed.why: Regular surfaces, the first and second fundamental forms, the Gauss map, Gaussian and mean curvature.

proposed.title: Geodesics and the Gauss–Bonnet theorem
proposed.subject: Differential geometry
proposed.why: Theorema Egregium, parallel transport and geodesics; total curvature equals 2π times the Euler characteristic.

proposed.title: Smooth manifolds
proposed.subject: Differential geometry
proposed.why: Spaces that are locally Euclidean, with smooth maps, tangent spaces, immersions, submanifolds and Sard's theorem; the setting of general relativity and mechanics.

proposed.title: Vector fields and flows
proposed.subject: Differential geometry
proposed.why: Vector fields, integral curves, flows and the Lie bracket; dynamics on a manifold.

proposed.title: Vector bundles
proposed.subject: Differential geometry
proposed.why: Families of vector spaces over a manifold; tangent and cotangent bundles first, then the bundles whose sections are gauge fields.

proposed.title: Tensor fields and Riemannian metrics
proposed.subject: Differential geometry
proposed.why: Tensor analysis on manifolds and metrics measuring length and angle; the language of general relativity.

proposed.title: Differential forms
proposed.subject: Differential geometry
proposed.why: Alternating forms, wedge product, exterior derivative and integration on manifolds; Maxwell's equations become dF = 0, d*F = J.

proposed.title: De Rham cohomology
proposed.subject: Differential geometry
proposed.why: Closed modulo exact forms; de Rham's theorem identifies it with singular cohomology.

proposed.title: Symplectic geometry
proposed.subject: Differential geometry
proposed.why: Symplectic forms and Hamiltonian vector fields; the geometric form of classical mechanics.

proposed.title: Normed and Banach spaces
proposed.subject: Functional analysis
proposed.why: Complete normed vector spaces and bounded linear operators; linear algebra in infinite dimensions.

proposed.title: Hilbert spaces
proposed.subject: Functional analysis
proposed.why: Complete inner-product spaces: orthonormal bases, projections and the Riesz representation theorem; the state space of quantum mechanics.

proposed.title: The contraction mapping principle
proposed.subject: Functional analysis
proposed.why: Banach's fixed-point theorem, with existence and uniqueness for ODEs (Picard–Lindelöf) and convergence of iterative methods as applications.

proposed.title: The Hahn–Banach theorem
proposed.subject: Functional analysis
proposed.why: Extending functionals and separating convex sets; makes dual spaces large enough to use.

proposed.title: Baire category and the open mapping theorem
proposed.subject: Functional analysis
proposed.why: The Baire category theorem gives uniform boundedness, open mapping and closed graph theorems.

proposed.title: Compact operators and the Fredholm alternative
proposed.subject: Functional analysis
proposed.why: Operators that behave like matrices, and when Ax − λx = y is solvable; used for integral equations and boundary-value problems.

proposed.title: Distributions
proposed.subject: Harmonic analysis
proposed.why: Generalised functions such as the Dirac delta, weak derivatives and Fourier transforms of them; the setting for Green's functions.

proposed.title: Stability and bifurcations
proposed.subject: Dynamical systems
proposed.why: Fixed points, linearisation, phase portraits and how they change with a parameter (saddle-node, pitchfork, Hopf).

proposed.title: Limit cycles
proposed.subject: Dynamical systems
proposed.why: Isolated periodic orbits, the Poincaré–Bendixson theorem and relaxation oscillations.

proposed.title: Chaos and strange attractors
proposed.subject: Dynamical systems
proposed.why: The Lorenz system, the logistic map, period doubling, fractals and strange attractors.

proposed.title: Ergodic theory
proposed.subject: Dynamical systems
proposed.why: Time averages equal space averages (Birkhoff); underlies statistical mechanics and Furstenberg's proof of Szemerédi's theorem.

proposed.title: Laplace's equation
proposed.subject: Partial differential equations
proposed.why: Harmonic functions, mean-value property, maximum principle and Green's functions; electrostatics and steady states.

proposed.title: The heat equation
proposed.subject: Partial differential equations
proposed.why: Diffusion: fundamental solution, smoothing and the maximum principle; connects to Brownian motion.

proposed.title: The wave equation
proposed.subject: Partial differential equations
proposed.why: D'Alembert's and Kirchhoff's formulas, finite propagation speed, energy; vibrating strings, sound and light.

proposed.title: Calculus of variations
proposed.subject: Partial differential equations
proposed.why: Euler–Lagrange equations and minimisers of functionals; the principle of least action and Lagrangian field theory.

proposed.title: Sobolev spaces
proposed.subject: Partial differential equations
proposed.why: Functions with weak derivatives in L^p; embedding theorems make weak solutions precise.

proposed.title: Elliptic equations and weak solutions
proposed.subject: Partial differential equations
proposed.why: Lax–Milgram, regularity and maximum principles for second-order elliptic equations.

proposed.title: Conditional expectation and martingales
proposed.subject: Probability
proposed.why: Conditional expectation as a projection and fair-game processes; optional stopping and martingale convergence.

proposed.title: Brownian motion
proposed.subject: Probability
proposed.why: The continuous random walk: construction, Markov property and its link to the heat equation.

proposed.title: Point estimation
proposed.subject: Statistics
proposed.why: Sufficiency, maximum likelihood, Bayes estimators, bias–variance and the Cramér–Rao bound.

proposed.title: Hypothesis testing and confidence intervals
proposed.subject: Statistics
proposed.why: Tests, p-values, the Neyman–Pearson lemma and interval estimates.

proposed.title: Linear regression
proposed.subject: Statistics
proposed.why: Least-squares fitting of linear models, analysis of variance and inference on coefficients.

proposed.title: Propositional and first-order logic
proposed.subject: Logic and set theory
proposed.why: Formal languages, truth assignments, structures and satisfaction; how a mathematical statement is made precise.
supported_by: Enderton, ch. 2 (§§ First-Order Languages; Truth and Models)

proposed.title: Completeness and compactness theorems
proposed.subject: Logic and set theory
proposed.why: Everything true in all models is provable; consequences include compactness, Löwenheim–Skolem and nonstandard analysis.
supported_by: Enderton, ch. 2 (§§ A Deductive Calculus; Soundness and Completeness Theorems; Models of Theories; Nonstandard Analysis)

proposed.title: Gödel's incompleteness theorems
proposed.subject: Logic and set theory
proposed.why: Arithmetisation of syntax, recursive functions and undecidability; no consistent recursive theory proves all truths of arithmetic.

proposed.title: Ordinals, cardinals and the axiom of choice
proposed.subject: Logic and set theory
proposed.why: ZFC axioms, transfinite induction, cardinal arithmetic, Zorn's lemma and well-ordering.

proposed.title: Forcing and independence
proposed.subject: Logic and set theory
proposed.why: The constructible universe and forcing show the continuum hypothesis is independent of ZFC.

proposed.title: Planar graphs
proposed.subject: Graph theory
proposed.why: Euler's formula, Kuratowski's theorem and plane duality.

proposed.title: Network flows
proposed.subject: Graph theory
proposed.why: Max-flow min-cut and flow–colouring duality; the combinatorial core of linear programming on graphs.

proposed.title: Graph minors and tree-width
proposed.subject: Graph theory
proposed.why: Tree-decompositions, well-quasi-ordering and the Robertson–Seymour graph minor theorem.

proposed.title: p-adic numbers
proposed.subject: Number theory
proposed.why: The completion Q_p, valuations, local fields and their extensions; the existing pages treat v_p only as an integer-valued tool.

proposed.title: Units in number fields
proposed.subject: Number theory
proposed.why: Minkowski's lattice methods give finiteness of the class number and Dirichlet's unit theorem.

proposed.title: Class field theory
proposed.subject: Number theory
proposed.why: Abelian extensions of a number field are described by its ideles; local and global reciprocity laws generalise quadratic reciprocity.

proposed.title: Artin L-functions
proposed.subject: Number theory
proposed.why: L-functions attached to Galois representations; Artin conductors, functional equation and Chebotarev density.

proposed.title: Algebraic varieties
proposed.subject: Algebraic geometry
proposed.why: Affine and projective varieties, the Nullstellensatz, morphisms, rational maps and nonsingularity.

proposed.title: Sheaves and schemes
proposed.subject: Algebraic geometry
proposed.why: Sheaves, Spec of a ring and gluing; Grothendieck's foundation of modern algebraic geometry.

proposed.title: Sheaf cohomology
proposed.subject: Algebraic geometry
proposed.why: Derived-functor and Čech cohomology of sheaves, cohomology of projective space and Serre duality.

proposed.title: Riemann–Roch theorem
proposed.subject: Algebraic geometry
proposed.why: Divisors, line bundles and genus on a curve; counts functions with prescribed poles.

proposed.title: Weil conjectures
proposed.subject: Algebraic geometry
proposed.why: Zeta functions of varieties over finite fields: rationality, functional equation and the Riemann hypothesis (Deligne).

proposed.title: Conditioning and numerical stability
proposed.subject: Numerical analysis
proposed.why: Floating-point arithmetic, condition numbers and backward stability; what makes an algorithm trustworthy.

proposed.title: Least squares and QR factorisation
proposed.subject: Numerical analysis
proposed.why: Projectors, Gram–Schmidt, Householder QR and the least-squares problem.

proposed.title: Interpolation and numerical integration
proposed.subject: Numerical analysis
proposed.why: Polynomial and spline interpolation, best approximation, and Newton–Cotes and Gaussian quadrature.

proposed.title: Numerical methods for ODEs
proposed.subject: Numerical analysis
proposed.why: One-step and multistep methods, consistency, stability and convergence; shooting and finite differences for boundary-value problems.

proposed.title: Convex optimisation
proposed.subject: Optimisation
proposed.why: Linear, quadratic and semidefinite programs, and why convex problems have no spurious local minima.

proposed.title: Optimisation algorithms
proposed.subject: Optimisation
proposed.why: Gradient descent, Newton's method and interior-point methods, with convergence rates; the methods used to train machine-learning models.

proposed.title: Categories, functors and natural transformations
proposed.subject: Category theory
proposed.why: Objects and morphisms in general, maps between categories, and equivalence of categories.

proposed.title: The Yoneda lemma
proposed.subject: Category theory
proposed.why: An object is determined by its maps to or from other objects; universal properties and representable functors.

proposed.title: Limits and colimits
proposed.subject: Category theory
proposed.why: Products, pullbacks, equalisers and their duals as universal cones.

proposed.title: Adjoint functors
proposed.subject: Category theory
proposed.why: Free–forgetful pairs and their units and counits; adjoints preserve limits.

notes: Per the site owner's clarification, chapters that are a more advanced treatment of an existing topic are mapped to that concept (marked with a note) instead of getting a new page; several existing pages (fourier-poisson, spectral-theorem, convexity, vector-calculus, lagrange-multipliers, limit-theorems, lebesgue, elliptic-curves, ideals) would have to grow to carry that material.
'stage' gives the level at which a student usually first meets the topic; each proposed page is meant to serve all levels.
'subject' on each proposal is its suggested topic group; topic_groups lists the same grouping in order.
